note: Curated tiles for the empty state. Edit here; the panel picks 'slots' tiles per new chat. mode: run sends, draft fills the input. kind: utility|creative. requires: none|comp|selection (reserved for context-aware picking). icon: a GafferIcons key. title ~18 chars, result ~28 chars.

tiles.title: Clean Up Comp
tiles.prompt: Clean up the active comp: give layers clear names, label and colour them by type, and group related layers into precomps where it helps. Show me the plan briefly, then do it without changing how the comp looks or animates.

tiles.title: Relink footage
tiles.prompt: Find any missing footage in this project and help me relink it. List what is missing and where you will look before changing anything.

tiles.title: Unused footage
tiles.prompt: List the footage and comps in this project that no layer uses, grouped by folder. Only list them; do not delete anything.

tiles.title: Read expressions
tiles.prompt: Go through the expressions in the active comp and explain in plain language what each one does, grouped by layer. Flag any that look fragile or slow.

tiles.title: Fix expressions
tiles.prompt: Find expressions with errors in the active comp, tell me what is wrong with each, then fix them while keeping the animation the same.

tiles.title: Queue for render
tiles.prompt: Add the comps I name to the render queue with sensible output settings. Ask me which comps and which format first. Only queue them; do not start rendering.

tiles.title: Import from Figma
tiles.prompt: Import a Figma frame into this project as layers. Ask me for the Figma link, then bring the frame in and keep its layer names.

tiles.title: Loading spinner
tiles.prompt: Create a smooth looping loading spinner in a new comp, with controls for colour, size and speed.

tiles.title: Lego brick
tiles.result: One rig for size and colour.
tiles.prompt: Build a 3D Lego brick that I can resize and recolour from one control layer, using shape layers and expressions.

tiles.title: Confetti
tiles.prompt: Add a confetti burst to the active comp with controls for amount, colours and gravity.

tiles.title: Lower third
tiles.prompt: Build an animated lower third with a name and a title line, with controls for text, colour and timing, in the active comp.

tiles.title: Logo reveal
tiles.prompt: Animate the selected layer as a logo reveal: a clean scale and mask reveal with a soft ease. Keep the controls on one layer so I can adjust timing.

tiles.title: Count-up number
tiles.prompt: Create a number that counts up to a value I choose, in a new comp, with controls for start, end, duration and prefix or suffix.

tiles.title: Write-on stroke
tiles.prompt: Animate the selected shape path drawing on, using Trim Paths, with controls for duration and easing.

tiles.title: Shake rig
tiles.prompt: Add a shake to the selected layer with a single slider for amount and one for speed, using wiggle expressions on a control layer.

tiles.title: Parallax depth
tiles.prompt: Turn the selected layers into a parallax move: place them at different depths with a camera and a gentle push-in.

tiles.title: Audio bars
tiles.prompt: Build a set of bars that react to the selected audio layer, with controls for bar count, colour and sensitivity.

tiles.title: Glitch hit
tiles.prompt: Add a short glitch hit to the selected layer: a few frames of displacement and colour split, with a control for intensity.

tiles.title: Make it loop
tiles.prompt: Make the selected layer's animation loop seamlessly, using a loop expression where it fits, and tell me what you changed.
